title: Create your first drop
summary: A drop is a batch of Tikkas behind one link. Your first one is free.

steps.title: Start a drop
steps.body: Go to Drops and tap "Create a drop". You need to set up your card first.

steps.title: Pick a goal
steps.body: Choose what you want the drop to do: Get new customers, Bring customers back, or Fill quiet days. Tikka suggests offers that work for that goal.

steps.title: Pick an offer
steps.body:
Pick one of the ready-made offers for your kind of business, then change the amounts if you want. Or tap "Make my own" to choose every reward yourself.

There are three kinds of Tikka: Legendary (very few), Rare (some) and Thank-you (everyone else). A thank-you Tikka always gives something small, so nobody walks away with nothing.

steps.title: Choose the size and how long
steps.body:
Tell Tikka about how many people see your posts, and it suggests how many Tikkas to make. Then choose when it starts (as soon as you publish, or a date) and how long each Tikka lasts after someone claims it: 7, 14 or 30 days.

"Who can claim" and the marketplace settings are under More options. The usual choices are already set.

steps.title: Check and publish
steps.body: You see your drop the way customers will. Check the rewards, then tap Publish. Your first drop is free; after that, the price shows on the button before you pay.

steps.title: Share it
steps.body: Your drop page opens with your link and share images. See "Share your drop" next.

tips: Make a few more Tikkas than you expect people to claim. Running out turns people away.
You can run one drop at a time, and schedule your next one while it runs.
